for_senior_author: Interpretation gap of sc_vickers_smith_2025 (card: minor; second reader 147: moderate; open since the adjudication). The supplement bears on it. The strip group's baseline lead in the same behaviours (median composite score 8 against 7, eTable 4) is about the size of the adjusted follow-up difference (0.86). No model adjusted for it (eMethods). The daily gap neither closed nor widened over four weeks (eFigure 1). So the Key Points' wording of 'demonstrating the role of FTS' and the Discussion's statement that the association remained after adjusting for confounders go beyond a design that shows co-occurrence. My reading is 'substantial' (the schema has no 'moderate'); the card stays at minor until you decide.

Age modification of the overdose estimate: I kept it in the magnitude of cl_dc_overdose_strip_users with a qualifier (bands overlap at every age; one of 7 modifiers tested for overdose, 13 in all; absent without adjustment; P values called descriptive by the authors). Dropping it from the claim altogether is a defensible alternative; your choice.
